Name: A Salted Egg Set
Author: CamelliaGasStation
Description:
Lets you use Preserves Jars to make Salted Duck Eggs, which aren't edible (please don't eat the shell) but can be used for cooking. And mayo, I guess.
‎

[b]Uninstalling:[/b]
Delete all items from this mod before removing the files.
